basis: Publisher ingredient lists and methods distinguish required quantities from optional additions. Existing uncooked plans adopt corrected requirements; saved pantry and cooked status are preserved.

replace: ; 50g rye or spelt flour (optional – use a total of 200g self-raising flour if you prefer)
corrections.note: Includes 150g self-raising flour and 50g rye flour for the full cake. The publisher also offers 200g self-raising flour instead of that combination; this shopping list uses rye.

replace: zest and juice 1 lemon plus 1 lemon cut into wedges to serve
1 lemon cut into wedges to serve
corrections.note: Includes one lemon for the marinade plus half a lemon for the tzatziki per four servings. The extra serving lemon is not included.

replace: 2 limes juiced, plus wedges to serve (optional)
Additional dusting/greasing/serving amounts are not included: 1 tbsp honey plus 1 tsp
corrections.note: Includes two limes for the dressing and the full tablespoon plus teaspoon of honey (20ml) per four servings. Extra serving wedges are optional.

replace: 1 lemon juiced, plus extra to serve (optional)
corrections.note: Includes one lemon for the hummus per four servings; extra lemon for serving is optional.

replace: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil plus extra to serve (optional)
corrections.note: Includes two tablespoons of olive oil (30ml) for cooking the full recipe. Extra serving oil remains optional.

replace: Planning conversion: 2 large  sweet potatoes (about 500g/1lb 4oz each) → 400g Sweet potatoes
Publisher weight allowance: two sweet potatoes at about 500g each, about 1kg total.
Additional dusting/greasing/serving amounts are not included: 2 tbsp fresh  thyme leaves, plus 2 sprigs of fresh thyme
Both the measured thyme leaves and two additional sprigs are included.
corrections.note: Uses the publisher allowance of two sweet potatoes at about 500g each (1000g total), replacing the generic size estimate. Includes 2 tbsp thyme leaves plus two sprigs placed in the parcels; sprigs stay separate from spoon-measured leaves.

replace: Additional dusting/greasing/serving amounts are not included: 135g semi-sweet chocolate chips, plus 2 tbsp for topping
The measured chocolate topping is included.
corrections.note: Includes 135g chocolate chips in the batter and the publisher's measured 22g topping, 157g total. No spoon-to-weight estimate is needed. Follow the publisher method for the hot water, which is not a shopping item.
